Qualcomm-446721534311.title: AI Compiler & Kernel Engineer
Qualcomm-446721534311.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm Cloud AI is seeking an experienced
AI Compiler & Kernel Engineer
to develop and optimize high-performance AI operators for large-scale cloud inference workloads. You will work across model, compiler, runtime, and hardware layers to maximize inference performance while minimizing memory footprint and resource utilization on Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and optimize AI kernels and operators for Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms.
Enable and optimize LLM, MoE, and multimodal models for large-scale cloud inference.
Drive accuracy, performance and efficiency optimizations across the software stack.
Improve model memory footprint and ROM / RAM efficiency through kernel, graph, and compiler optimizations.
Collaborate with performance and modeling teams to deliver best-in-class inference efficiency.
Analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks using profiling, benchmarking, and modeling methodologies.
Qualcomm-446721534311.requirements:
Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
5+ years of experience in Cloud AI inference, kernel/operator development, or AI compiler technologies.
Good verbal and written English communication skills for effective collaboration across global teams.
Proficiency in C++, Python, and Linux development environments.
Deep understanding of Transformer architectures, such as LLMs, MoE, and modern foundation models.
Strong experience with compiler technologies such as MLIR, Triton, TVM, or similar frameworks, including graph transformation, operator lowering, scheduling, operator fusion, kernel auto-tuning, code generation and memory scheduling.
Strong experience with parallel computing architectures and performance optimization techniques, including vectorization, tiling, memory hierarchy optimization, and workload scheduling.
Strong experience with graph optimization, model accuracy validation, performance optimization, and memory optimization.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience optimizing transformer-related operators such as Attention, FlashAttention, KV Cache, Embedding, GEMM, Softmax, and MoE routing is highly desirable.
Hands-on experience developing custom operators and high-performance kernels, either manually or through compiler frameworks such as MLIR or Triton with AI accelerator platforms, such as GPUs, NPUs, TPUs, or custom AI hardware.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
•    2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail

Qualcomm-446720446607.title: AI System Architect (NPU / GPU / Interconnect)
Qualcomm-446720446607.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering
General Summary:
We are seeking
experienced architects
with deep expertise in
AI accelerators (NPU), GPUs, and/or high-performance system interconnects
to define next-generation AI and data center compute platforms.
Successful candidates will possess strong architectural knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
AI accelerator and NPU architecture
GPU architecture, graphics, and compute systems
High-performance system interconnects and data center fabrics
Key Responsibilities
Customer & Platform Architecture
Engage with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand AI workload requirements, deployment scenarios, performance targets, and system constraints.
Translate customer and market requirements into scalable system architecture, technology roadmaps, and platform features.
Drive architecture tradeoff analysis across performance, power, cost, scalability, and deployment requirements to influence product direction.
One or More of the Following Domains:
AI / NPU Architecture
Analyze and optimize AI workloads including LLMs, Transformers, computer vision, multimodal AI, and recommendation systems.
Drive HW/SW co-design across architecture, compiler, runtime, driver, and framework layers.
Lead performance analysis and optimization across compute, memory, and communication subsystems.
GPU & Graphics Architecture
Analyze graphics, rendering, compute, and AI workloads to optimize performance, efficiency, and scalability.
Drive architecture of GPU compute pipelines, graphics pipelines, memory systems, scheduling, and data movement.
Collaborate with graphics software, driver, runtime, and application teams to optimize workload execution and user experience.
System Interconnect & Data Center Architecture
Architect high-performance data movement across compute, memory, storage, and networking subsystems.
Define scale-up and scale-out architectures using PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, UALink, or similar communication fabrics.
Drive architecture of cache-coherent fabrics, memory hierarchies, chiplet communication, and distributed AI systems.
Lead system-level architecture decisions for scalability,
performance-per-watt,
latency, and overall system efficiency.
Qualcomm-446720446607.requirements:
BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
10+ years of experience in AI accelerator, GPU, high-performance compute, system architecture, or related disciplines.
Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas:
AI accelerator / NPU architecture
GPU architecture, graphics pipeline, and compute architecture
High-performance interconnects and communication fabrics
Data center system architecture
Memory hierarchy and bandwidth optimization
AI workload performance analysis and modeling
Strong HW/SW co-design background with a solid understanding of how AI software stacks, compilers, runtimes, and drivers utilize underlying hardware resources.
Demonstrated ability to drive architecture decisions across hardware, software, memory, and communication subsystems.
Language Requirements
Fluent in both
Mandarin Chinese and English
.
Able to lead technical discussions and collaborate effectively across global engineering teams.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 8+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 7+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

Qualcomm-446715657949.title: GPU Developer Tools Engineer
Qualcomm-446715657949.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Interested in enabling next generation graphics, games, ray tracing, machine learning, image and video processing, even Mars drones? In the GPU Developer Tools team, you will contribute to initiatives that provide developers the capabilities to learn, debug, and advance these technologies and more.
The Qualcomm Adreno GPU Software team is looking for talented engineers to work on next generation GPU Developer Tools. Responsibilities include the design and development of profiling and performance analysis tools, GPU debugging tools, collaborating with GPU hardware and software teams on performance validation and analysis, new feature development, debugging issues, optimizing for the user experience, and working with the developer ecosystem, our partners, and OEMs. This role is an opportunity to shape how developers optimize for the Snapdragon Adreno GPU and have insight into next generation GPU hardware design.
Our efforts in GPU Developer Tools create opportunities for our team members to learn new technologies and engage in full stack development ranging from user interfaces to graphics driver instrumentation. Experience in developing real-time software applications, graphics and/or GPGPU applications, games, middleware, drivers, or developer tools is a big plus.
In this role, you will:
Design and develop profiling, performance analysis, and debugging tools features.
Collaborate with GPU hardware and software teams on performance validation and analysis.
Debug issues, optimize for the user experience, and work with the developer ecosystem, partners, and OEMs.
Shape how developers optimize for the Snapdragon Adreno GPU and gain insight into next generation GPU hardware design.
The ideal candidate will meet two or more qualifications:
6+ years of professional experience
Extensive programming knowledge in C/C++
Deep knowledge of GPU hardware and graphics concepts
Demonstrated leadership skills, guiding and mentoring other engineers, driving projects to completion, and ensuring the highest standards of quality and innovation
One or more of the following qualifications is a plus:
Experience developing graphics applications with Vulkan, DirectX, Metal, OpenGL, WebGL or graphics development through Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot or a comparable graphics or game engine
Experience developing GPU computing applications with OpenCL, CUDA, SYCL etc.
Experience debugging, optimizing, profiling, and tuning real-time graphics and/or compute applications
Experience with game engines, graphics frameworks, or general computing frameworks leveraging the GPU
Knowledge of recent graphics trends, especially ray tracing and emerging capabilities such as mesh shading and workgraphs
Familiarity with Graphics Profilers and Debuggers such as Nsight, PIX, GPA, RenderDoc, Radeon Profilers, GfxReconstruct

Qualcomm-446721234627.title: GPU Performance Analysis Engineer
Qualcomm-446721234627.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
This role requires understanding of GPU bottlenecks. This also requires understanding how rendering for games work (their graphics pipelines) as well as to be able to write small rendering applications using the gpu using graphics APIs such as vulkan and hlsl/glsl/spirv. For this role you need to be able to analyze performance silicon measurements in Android.
Responsibilities:
In this role, your work will have critical impact in influencing next generation GPUs to be more efficient and to maintain competitive edge in Qualcomm Graphics solutions.
You will be contributing to performance analysis at GPU level for Graphics and Raytracing workloads such as benchmark/games by exploiting different SW/HW/Architectural knobs to find opportunities to improve perf.
Be engaged and contribute to competitive perf/power analysis for popular benchmark/games and to identify or be able to explain the gaps with reasonable evidence which could lead to next generation architecture/HW/SW enhancement opportunities.
Develop tools for efficient, streamlined and scalable debug/validation tasks.
Support presilicon workload enablement efforts for the analyzed workloads and games
Minimum Skills
Understanding of GPU architecture
Rendering knowledge and the ability to write rendering applications with vulkan and other graphics APIs
Strong knowledge of python and C++
Performance analysis experience
Sharp analytical skillset
Fluency in usage of latest AI tools for coding/debugging to solve system level problem
Minimum of Bachelor degree required
Fluent English communication skill
Preferred Skills
Masters degree or PhD
3-7 years of relevant experience
Android experience
GFXR capture/playback for vulkan. Render doc capture and interpretation of the data.
Experience in competitive performance for GPU centric use cases
Post-si debugging experience

Job Area:

Qualcomm is seeking experienced talents to join the Business Development team in China to drive the corporate level collaborations and business strategy execution with leading Cloud Service Providers(CSPs) and AI Industry customers/partners,  to manage overall account strategy, develop and orchestrate the corporate level partnership with CSPs, LLM players, Internet Service Providers, AI service software and hardware developers including IDC Server OEMs or System Integrators.

Qualcomm-446721007423.title: Director/Staff Manager, Data Center AI Product Marketing – China
Qualcomm-446721007423.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Product Marketing
General Summary:
Role Overview
Qualcomm is looking for an experienced business and product marketing leader to drive the growth of its Data Center AI business in China. This role will focus on strategic product marketing with cloud service providers, internet companies, AI infrastructure players, OEMs/ODMs, system integrators, and ecosystem partners to accelerate Qualcomm’s adoption in AI data center, inference acceleration, custom silicon, and heterogeneous computing platforms.
The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of technology understanding, product strategy, ecosystem development, senior-level customer engagement, and commercial execution. This person will be responsible for translating Qualcomm’s technology capabilities into customer-relevant solutions, shaping go-to-market strategies, and driving design wins and commercial partnerships across the China data center ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Marketing & GTM Strategy
Define China-specific go-to-market strategy for Qualcomm’s data center AI platforms, including positioning, value proposition, competitive differentiation, and customer segmentation.
Translate customer requirements into actionable product, roadmap, and ecosystem feedback for internal product and engineering teams.
Develop market insights on AI infrastructure trends, cloud workloads, LLM inference, heterogeneous computing, accelerator adoption, and China domestic platform requirements.
Partner with global product management, engineering, sales, and strategy teams to align Qualcomm’s product roadmap with China market opportunities.
Create executive-level business cases, customer proposals, competitive analysis, and strategic recommendations.
2. AI Ecosystem & Technology Partnership

Qualcomm-446715068698.title: AI SDK Software Engineer
Qualcomm-446715068698.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Job overview:
As a member of Qualcomm China's engineering team dedicated to automotive infotainment and ADAS platforms, you will play a pivotal role in advancing embedded deep learning solutions. We are seeking skilled engineers with expertise in machine learning to drive innovation and development in this dynamic domain.
Our objective is to seamlessly integrate high-performance software with advanced hardware, enabling rapid execution of deep neural networks. This approach is designed to optimize and enrich the driving experience—particularly in ADAS and GenAI applications—by leveraging the full potential of Snapdragon chipsets embedded within modern vehicles.
In this position, you will work extensively with neural network frameworks such as PyTorch and ONNX, contributing to the continuous enhancement of our neural network inference engine to support cutting-edge deep learning models emerging from both academia and industry. You will also be responsible for optimizing and fine-tuning these applications for Qualcomm’s next-generation hardware acceleration platforms, including DSP, GPU, and CPU, ensuring maximum performance and efficiency.
The work scope includes but not limit to:
Feature development and bug fix in Qualcomm Neural network SDK (QNN/AI Engine Direct SDK). Develop neural network operator kernels using Hexagon DSP or SIMD accelerator. Optimize performance and tune accuracy for models with Qualcomm AI Toolchains. Algorithms prototype design and implementation for standard and user-defined operators. Practice quantization-aware training and post-training quantization. Collaborate with different regional teams on new feature design and implementation. Support the testing team to improve the quality of AI Toolchains. Assist customers in efficiently deploying their neural networks.
Qualcomm-446715068698.requirements:
5-6 years of software development experience with the ability to independently complete projects on edge platforms. Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., C++, Python). Strong problem-solving and logical thinking skills. Excellent communication skills, capable of effective collaboration with cross-functional teams. Experience with agile development methodologies is a plus. Have the concept of SDK development for variant system platforms. Familiar with ARM architecture-based hardware and software.
Preferred Qualifications:
Enthusiasm for machine learning technology and hands-on experience in designing and implementing deep learning networks using modern frameworks. Familiarity with popular quantization frameworks such as ONNX QDQ, PyTorch, TensorFlow, PPQ, TensorRT. Experience with model accuracy analysis, problem-solving, and debugging. Proven experience in software design, problem-solving, debugging, documentation, and presentation. Practical experience with deep learning inference frameworks such as QNN, TfLite, NCNN, TNN, MACE. Familiarity with popular deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow. Experience with parallel programming, such as OpenCL, NEON, OpenMP, CUDA. DSP software development and algorithm implementation experience, familiarity with Hexagon/HVX is a big plus. Experience in quantization tuning for GenAI models on edge and related inference acceleration is a strong plus. Experience with ADAS/VLA, GenAI/LLM/LVM, or ASR/NLP related models' deployment is a plus.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
•    2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

General Summary:
Role Summary
We are seeking a AI solution Software Engineer focused on
end-to-end latency optimization
across heterogeneous compute IPs (GPU, NPU, ISP, CPU).
You will play a key role in
designing, profiling, and optimizing using low latency cross-IP signaling protocol(Synx)
for AI, camera, and graphics pipelines. This position involves close collaboration with camera, GPU, DSP, AI, and kernel teams to deliver
low-latency, power-efficient solutions
for leading OEMs
Key Responsibilities
Own cross‑IP synchronization architecture
(GPU/DSP/ISP/CPU), designing
Synx
flows and HW fence interop to minimize cross
IP(ISP/NSP/GPU/EVA.etc)
communication latency.
Work with global team to
do Synx solution optimization and China OEM Feature request development
Design & integrate Synx interop
(e.g., ICP↔NSP, EVA↔NSP) including queueing, signaling, error/flush/SSR handling, and async execution models for AI nodes, shepherd feature commercialization.
Partner with kernel, camera (CamX), GPU, and AI teams
to co‑design buffer lifecycle and synchronization semantics (DirectLink or native Synx) to avoid unnecessary copies, RPC overheads, and wakeups.
Guide OEMs to optimize
their customized use cases using Qualcomm’s cross-IP synchronization mechanism.

Qualcomm-446718782666.title: Camera AI Engineer (IoT)
Qualcomm-446718782666.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Job Overview
Artificial Intelligence is changing the world for the benefit of human beings and societies. QUALCOMM, as the world’s leading mobile computing platform provider, is committed to enable the wide deployment of intelligent solutions on all possible devices – like smart phones, laptops, autonomous vehicles, robotics and IoT devices. Qualcomm is creating building blocks for the intelligent edge.
We are seeking a passionate and hands-on Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI Software team in China. You will support Model Onboarding requests for Qualcomm’s China customers, helping take customer and third-party models from initial request to production-ready deployment on Qualcomm Snapdragon platforms. Workloads span the full model spectrum – from large language models (LLMs) and generative AI models to latency-critical vision, audio, and multimodal networks.
The role is grounded in Qualcomm’s AI technology stack: Snapdragon SoCs, the Hexagon NPU (HTP), Adreno GPU, and Qualcomm’s AI software and SDKs including QAIRT (Qualcomm AI Runtime SDK). You will use these tools to analyze, quantize, convert, and deploy models, and to debug and fine-tune their accuracy and performance on simulation and on real hardware.
Roles & Responsibilities
•  Support Model Onboarding requests from Qualcomm customers in China, helping drive each request from intake through production deployment across LLMs, generative AI, vision, audio, and multimodal models.
•  Analyze and adapt customer models: review architectures (CNNs, transformers, LLMs, diffusion, and multimodal networks), identify unsupported operators or structures, and adapt models for efficient execution on Qualcomm hardware.
•  Quantize, convert, and compile models from common frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) into Qualcomm runtime formats using QAIRT and related Qualcomm AI tools, applying PTQ/QAT and LLM/GenAI techniques (weight-only, activation, and KV-cache quantization, mixed-precision; Lora, Batch, etc) to meet targets.
•  Validate model inference via simulation (x86 reference) and on device, checking numerical correctness and functional behavior on the Hexagon NPU (HTP).
•  Debug and fine-tune accuracy and performance: analyze quantization error and layer-wise mismatches, profile latency, memory, and power (including LLM token rates and KV-cache footprint), and apply hardware-aware tuning to meet customer KPIs.
•  Collaborate with Qualcomm model, tool, framework, and SDK teams to align onboarding solutions with SoC and HTP capabilities, and to escalate gaps in operator or feature support.
•  Participate in the Software Development Life Cycle: requirement analysis, design reviews, development, testing, integration, debugging, and performance tuning.
Qualcomm-446718782666.requirements:
•  3+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning model deployment, optimization, or embedded AI development on IoT, mobile, or real-time embedded platforms.
•  Strong proficiency in Python and C/C++, including performance-critical, system-level programming and ML tooling workflows.
•  Solid understanding of deep learning model architectures – CNNs, transformers, LLMs, diffusion, and multimodal models – and common frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX.
•  Knowledge of model optimization techniques – quantization (PTQ/QAT), pruning, graph optimization, and hardware-aware model design – with strong analytical and debugging skills for accuracy and performance issues on real hardware.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Hands-on experience with Qualcomm AI SDKs – QAIRT (Qualcomm AI Runtime SDK) or Hexagon SDK – and with deploying models on Snapdragon using the Hexagon NPU (HTP) or Adreno GPU.
•  Experience optimizing or deploying LLMs and generative AI models (e.g. LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, Stable Diffusion, or similar VLM/LMM families), including weight-only and KV-cache quantization for on-device inference.
•  Familiarity with on-device and GenAI inference runtimes such as Llama.cpp and LiteRT, and with tensor layouts, transformations, and tensor-processing mathematics.
•  Experience using AI coding agents and assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development, debugging, and tooling workflows.
Education Requirements
Required:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.
Preferred:  Master’s or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
•    2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Qualcomm-446722024940.title: Data Center AI Software Senior Customer Engineer
Qualcomm-446722024940.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
Role Overview
The Data Center Customer Engineering team is seeking a Cloud AI Software Senior Engineer to support deployment and customer enablement of AI and generative AI workloads on Qualcomm Cloud AI inference accelerators. This role is designed for a strong software engineer with AI/ML exposure who can bring up customer workloads, integrate software components, automate validation, investigate functional and performance issues, and collaborate effectively with internal engineering teams. Deep expertise in LLM kernel optimization, distributed training, or rack-scale performance architecture is helpful but not required.
Key Responsibilities
·         Deploy, integrate, and validate AI/ML and LLM inference workloads on Qualcomm Cloud AI accelerator platforms.
·         Support customer model onboarding, environment setup, functional validation, basic performance benchmarking, and issue reproduction.
·         Work with AI frameworks, model conversion/deployment flows, runtime APIs, and accelerator software stacks to enable customer use cases.
·         Debug software issues across applications, frameworks, runtime, drivers, operating system, and platform interfaces; collect logs and traces and drive clear issue reports.
·         Perform basic LLM performance analysis using metrics such as latency, throughput, tokens/second, Time to First Token (TTFT), and resource utilization; escalate deep optimization topics to specialist teams when appropriate.
·         Create and maintain Python/Bash automation for model deployment, regression tests, benchmark execution, log collection, and result analysis.
·         Support single-server and basic multi-accelerator/multi-node validation; develop working knowledge of Scale-Up/Scale-Out and collective communication concepts such as AllReduce and AllGather.
·         Collaborate with model, runtime, compiler, driver, firmware, platform, and infrastructure teams to reproduce issues, identify ownership, and track resolution.
·         Assist customer PoCs and production-readiness activities, including release validation, upgrade testing, configuration verification, and technical documentation.
·         Document setup procedures, known issues, troubleshooting guides, benchmark results, and reusable customer enablement best practices.
Qualcomm-446722024940.requirements:
·         Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
·         Solid software development and debugging skills in Python and/or C/C++, plus practical Bash/Linux command-line experience.
·         Good understanding of Linux software environments, processes, memory, networking basics, logs, packages, containers, and system troubleshooting.
·         Practical exposure to AI/ML inference and at least one framework such as PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, Hugging Face Transformers, or an equivalent framework/runtime.
·         Basic understanding of Transformer and LLM concepts, including tokens, attention, context length, KV cache, prefill/decode, and common inference performance metrics.
·         Experience with software integration, validation, test automation, issue reproduction, and root-cause analysis across multiple software components.
·         Ability to analyze technical problems methodically and communicate findings clearly to internal engineering teams and customers.
·         Comfort working directly with customers or partners in evaluation,
integration, or technical support environments.
Preferred Qualifications
·         Experience deploying LLMs or generative-AI applications using Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, DeepSpeed, or similar software stacks.
·         Exposure to model optimization techniques such as quantization, batching, KV-cache management, or graph/runtime optimization.
·         Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes and common datacenter deployment workflows.
·         Basic knowledge of multi-GPU/multi-accelerator systems, PCIe/network topology, RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand, or collective communication.
·         Experience with performance profiling, benchmark automation, CI/CD, telemetry, or regression analysis.
·         Experience supporting accelerator, GPU, NPU, server, cloud, or other Linux-based compute platforms.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Qualcomm-446722025170.title: Data Center LLM Optimization Customer Engineer
Qualcomm-446722025170.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
The Data Center Customer Engineering team is seeking an experienced ML/Systems Engineer specializing in LLM inference optimization. This role works directly with strategic customers, partners, and internal engineering teams to deploy and optimize generative AI workloads on Qualcomm Cloud AI inference accelerators. The engineer will translate model-level requirements into efficient accelerator, memory, communication, and cluster configurations while driving measurable improvements in throughput, latency, scalability, power efficiency, and production reliability.
Key Responsibilities
·         Deploy and optimize LLM and multimodal inference workloads on Qualcomm Cloud AI accelerator platforms from single accelerator to multi-node/rack-scale configurations.
·         Profile and optimize prefill and decode performance, including Time to First Token (TTFT), Time per Output Token (TPOT), inter-token latency, tokens/second, throughput per user, and performance per watt.
·         Analyze model architecture and runtime bottlenecks across compute, accelerator memory, host memory, KV cache, interconnect, networking, and software stack.
·         Optimize model execution using techniques such as quantization (FP16/BF16/FP8/INT8/INT4 as platform-supported), batching, continuous/dynamic batching, KV-cache management, paged attention, prompt/context-length tuning, and speculative decoding where applicable.
·         Optimize distributed inference across tensor, pipeline, data, context, and expert parallelism; characterize collective communication including AllReduce, AllGather, ReduceScatter, and AllToAll.
·         Evaluate and tune Scale-Up and Scale-Out performance, including topology-aware workload placement, network bandwidth/latency, communication-compute overlap, and scaling efficiency.
·         Design and execute reproducible benchmark and stress-test methodologies across model size, batch size, input/output sequence length, concurrency, accelerator count, and node count; identify saturation points and performance regressions.
·         Bring up and validate customer LLMs and representative open-source models; establish performance baselines, optimization plans, and competitive/production-readiness reports.
·         Partner with runtime, compiler, firmware, driver, platform, networking, and model teams to debug cross-layer performance issues and drive root-cause resolution.
·         Build Python/Bash-based profiling, benchmarking, automation, and data-analysis tooling; document reusable optimization recipes, reference configurations, and best practices.
·         Work directly with customers during evaluation, PoC, design-win, and production phases; convert workload requirements into clear engineering actions and communicate performance trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders.
Qualcomm-446722025170.requirements:
·         Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, AI/ML, or a related technical field, with strong hands-on systems and performance engineering experience.
·         Strong understanding of Transformer/LLM inference, including attention, MHA/GQA/MQA, feed-forward networks, KV cache, prefill vs. decode behavior, and memory/computation characteristics.
·         Hands-on experience deploying and profiling LLM workloads using Python and at least one major ML framework such as PyTorch; ability to diagnose performance using traces, profiler data, logs, and system telemetry.
·         Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, batching, memory optimization, kernel/runtime tuning, and graph/compiler optimization.
·         Good understanding of distributed AI concepts, including multi-accelerator execution, collective communication, Scale-Up/Scale-Out fabrics, and common parallelism strategies.
·         Strong Linux skills and familiarity with containers and orchestration concepts (Docker/Kubernetes) used in datacenter AI deployments.
·         Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash; disciplined approach to benchmark reproducibility and performance-data analysis.
·         Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple engineering organizations.
Preferred Qualifications
·         Experience with high-performance LLM serving stacks or optimization frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, Hugging Face Transformers, DeepSpeed, or equivalent accelerator-specific runtimes.
·         Experience with model families such as Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, or other dense/MoE LLMs and multimodal models.
·         Knowledge of MoE architectures, expert parallelism, token routing, and AllToAll communication performance.
·         Experience with RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand or Ethernet-based AI fabrics, NUMA/topology awareness, and distributed performance analysis.
·         Familiarity with MLPerf Inference methodology, production observability, CI/CD performance regression testing, and capacity planning.
·         Experience supporting customer PoCs or production deployments of AI accelerators at server, rack, or cluster scale.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
•    2+ years of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
•    1+ year of experience with debugging techniques.

Qualcomm China

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering
General Summary:
The QC module design team is looking for a candidate in a leadership role, who will lead a team of engineers consisting of RF design engineers, baseband design engineers, software engineers and test engineers to design next generation of AI modules and 5G/6G modules for applications from robotics, IOT devices, automobile control, and industrial automation.

Work with all business units within QC to take ill-defined product requirements and then make proposals for various products with cost and time-to-market considerations, with a goal of putting the product on the market with the shortest design cycle and the least cost.

Lead the team to stay ahead of competition and constantly find ways to improve our products

Qualcomm-446714829336.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Job Function
We are looking for talent software developers for Qualcomm China gaming team, focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies in gaming. You will be engaged in developing and optimizing AI modules and features for games running on Qualcomm’s platforms.
You may not realize it, but the QCT division of Qualcomm produces many of the best mobile SOCs on the market. We've produced hundreds of millions of chipsets embedded in our industry-leading mobile phone chips. If you see someone using a smartphone, there's a good chance its processor is from Qualcomm.
Skills/Experience
Proficient in at least one of C, C++/Python programming languages is a must Good knowledge of computer architecture, multi process/thread programing, operating system, data structures and basic algorithms Knowledge and experience of developing commercialized software or research at one of below area:
experience with computer vision techniques relevant to game AI, including super resolution, frame generation, or scene understanding.
experience with speech-related AI, such as automatic speech recognition (ASR) and advanced TTS models.
experience with generative AI technologies, such as stable diffusion, large language models (LLM), and their applications within game AI.
experience with neural rendering techniques such as neural denoising, neural post-processing effects.
Strong ability to learn quickly and work independently within a multidisciplinary, and fast paced organization. Excellent communication, written and verbal English skills.
Responsibilities
Participate in the profiling and analysis of in-game AI to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Optimize AI algorithms and models for performance and efficiency on Qualcomm hardware. Collaborate in the development and demonstration of advanced Game AI features, such as procedural content generation, intelligent animation or game AI coach/companion.
Education Requirements
Master’s degree in computer engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering or related field.

General Summary:
Job overview:
As a member of Qualcomm China's engineering team dedicated to automotive infotainment and ADAS platforms, you will play a pivotal role in advancing embedded deep learning solutions. We are seeking skilled engineers with expertise in machine learning to drive innovation and development in this dynamic domain.
Our objective is to seamlessly integrate high-performance software with advanced hardware, enabling rapid execution of deep neural networks. This approach is designed to optimize and enrich the driving experience—particularly in ADAS and GenAI applications—by leveraging the full potential of Snapdragon chipsets embedded within modern vehicles.
In this position, you will work extensively with neural network frameworks such as PyTorch and ONNX, contributing to the continuous enhancement of our neural network inference engine to support cutting-edge deep learning models emerging from both academia and industry. You will also be responsible for optimizing and fine-tuning these applications for Qualcomm’s next-generation hardware acceleration platforms, including DSP, GPU, and CPU, ensuring maximum performance and efficiency.

Development and bug fix in Qualcomm Neural network SDK (QNN/AI Engine Direct SDK). Neural network operator development, with Hexagon DSP or SIMD accelerator. Performance and accuracy tuning and optimizations with QC AI Engine Direct SDK. Algorithms prototype design and implementation for user defined operators. Practices on quantization aware training and post-training quantization. Co-work with our global team on new feature design and implementation. Support testing team to improve the quality of our products. Support customer to deploy their neural networks with highest performance and accuracy.

Qualcomm-446716539339.title: Generative AI Algorithms Engineer
Qualcomm-446716539339.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm AI Research is looking for world-class algorithms engineers in general domain machine learning, especially generative AI, LLM, LVM, VLM and omni models. Come join a high-caliber team of engineers building advanced artificial intelligence technology, best-in-class solutions, and user friendly model optimization tools such as  Qualcomm Innovation Center’s AI Model Efficiency Toolkit (
https://github.com/quic/aimet
) to enable state-of-the-art networks to run on devices with limited power, memory, and computation
. M
embers of our team enjoy the opportunity to participate in cutting edge research while simultaneously contributing technology that will be deployed worldwide in our industry-leading devices. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary talented team working on on device generative AI optimization. Collaborate in a cross-functional environment spanning hardware, software and systems. See your design in action on industry-leading chips embedded in the next generation of smartphones, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and IOT devices.
The R&D work responsibility for this position
focuses on the following
Algorithms research and development in the area of LLM, LVM, VLM, omni models and other cutting‑edge generative model architectures.
Advanced
architecture
research and development for complex generative models,
including (but not limited to)
MoE
,
such as expert routing, load balancing, sparse activation, expert parallelism and others
Advanced quantization algorithms research and development for complex generative models,
including (but not limited to)
FlexRound, PrefixQuant, GPTQ, SpinQuant, Automatic mixed precision, and other INT/ FP Quant algorithms.
Experiments and research on generative models training and fine‑tuning, including pre‑training, SFT, PEFT, RL, reasoning, loss‑function design and optimization, as well as quantization‑aware training built on top of advanced quantization methods.
Efficient inference algorithms research and development, e.g. batching, KV caching, efficient attentions, long context, speculative decoding.
Model compression, lossy or lossless, structural and neural search.
Optimization based learning and learning based optimization.

Qualcomm-446719463617.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.
Qualcomm-446719463617.requirements:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
•    2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Job Description
Detailed Project Description
1. Focus on the design and implementation of key modules for the Generative AI inference runtime (Genie), enabling efficient execution of complex models on edge and embedded platforms.
2. Implement and optimize inference for large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on embedded and edge platforms, including improvements in execution efficiency, memory management, and resource utilization.
3. Design and optimize collaboration mechanisms between the inference runtime and Qualcomm chipsets, enhancing overall system performance and scalability.
4. Resolve system‑level performance and stability issues within Generative AI platforms.
5. Collaborate across teams to drive the adoption of Generative AI inference technologies in platform‑level use cases.
Skills / Experience Required
1. Deep understanding of LLM / LVM inference execution workflows, with system‑level design and implementation experience.
2. Proficient with Android / Linux development environments, with hands‑on experience on embedded or heterogeneous computing platforms.
3. Familiar with performance, memory, and concurrency optimization techniques in resource‑constrained environments.
4. Expert‑level proficiency in C++, with solid experience using Python and/or Java in system or AI engineering contexts.
5. Long‑term ownership experience with AI inference runtimes, AI acceleration technologies, or platform‑level components is a strong plus.
6. Experience with Qualcomm NPU deployment and development is highly preferred.

Qualcomm-446721646290.title: ANC Application Engineer
Qualcomm-446721646290.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
About the Role
This role mainly focuses on ANC application support for Qualcomm Bluetooth earbud and headphone chipsets, serving as the technical interface between customers and Qualcomm engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle. You will play a key role in shaping the ANC experience of next-generation consumer audio products.
Job Description
Lead ANC evaluation and tuning with customers to deliver optimal ANC performance.
Provide technical support across the product lifecycle, including design-win, tuning/testing, feature scoping, validation, and production.
Investigate and resolve ANC and system-level issues in collaboration with customers and Qualcomm engineering teams.
Deliver technical documentation, measurement reports, and tuning/application guides to customers.
Based in Shenzhen, with travel as needed (up to 30%).
Qualcomm-446721646290.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Acoustics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in audio/voice tuning, electro-acoustic simulation, acoustic measurement/automation, audio algorithm development, or DSP porting.
Solid understanding of audio signal processing, including IIR/FIR filters, FFT, and LMS.
Good understanding of room acoustics, electro-acoustic components (ADC/DAC, microphone, speaker), and measurement techniques, particularly for ANC.
Proven debugging and root-cause analysis skills for embedded or real-time audio systems.
Good written and spoken English for technical communication with customers and global teams.
Strong ability to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with ANC system design, including acoustic simulation, ANC filter design, adaptive ANC, wind noise reduction, or howling suppression.
Experience with Qualcomm ANC or Kymera audio framework.
Proficiency in MATLAB or Python for analysis, plus ML for voice or ANC processing.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with debugging techniques.

customer deployments and field issues

Qualcomm-446706877249.title: Automotive Software Architect
Qualcomm-446706877249.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
General Summary
Qualcomm is leveraging its expertise in wireless and computing technologies to drive a major technological revolution in the automotive industry. Having led the way in connected car technologies for over a decade, Qualcomm is now at the forefront of advancements in Automotive Infotainment, Telematics, ADAS/Autonomous Driving, and related technologies. The company is investing in cutting-edge innovations such as 5G, Cellular V2X, Computer Vision, and AI/Deep Learning. Collaborating closely with global automakers, Tier-1 suppliers, standards bodies, consortiums, and operators, Qualcomm is pushing the boundaries of automotive technology. The Qualcomm Automotive Team is seeking a SoC software architect to contribute to the development of next-generation automotive solutions.
As the SoC Software architect, you will be responsible for comprehending software product requirements, use cases, and applications, and their correlation to specific hardware blocks or sub-systems. Your role will involve defining software architecture for system requirements and collaborating with hardware and software teams to develop world-class solutions. The objective is to deliver top-tier, next-generation solutions to automotive customers worldwide.
Responsibilities include but not limited to:
Ownership and leadership of Architecture / Design / Development Strategy. Provide technical leadership and decision making to the product software development teams for software systems related matters.
Work with other organizations across the company to develop unified SW architectures and define SW interfaces.
Designs and implements software sub-systems for complex, large-scale products and systems.
Collaborate with internal and external team in the definition or selection of SW solutions.
Review and support in Detailed Design. Make recommendations and decisions on the SW implementation.
Interact with multiple technologists in the company and within the industry as well as between developers and project managers to evaluate feasibility of requirements and determine priorities for development.
Drives industry best practices for software engineering including ASPICE, FuSa and Cybersecurity compliance.
Availability in key meetings pertinent to the technical discussions
Communication of the technical solution internally and externally when needed.
Qualcomm-446706877249.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
10 years of software experience in embedded software development for ARM based systems
At the BS level, a minimum of 10 years, at the MS level, 8 years and at the PhD level, 5 years of software architecture experience.
SW Development background in Embedded Systems. Good C/C++, Rust etc. programming and analytic skills.
Preferred Qualifications

General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.

Qualcomm-446719091002.title: Automotive Systems Engineer
Qualcomm-446719091002.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
The candidate will work with a fast-paced automotive systems team working on Snapdragon™ SoCs for  leading car OEMs for digital cockpit and ADAS/AV solutions. The daily tasks will involve engaging with a globally diverse team of systems, HW and SW engineers across IP domains to understand program and data flows, corresponding performance requirements, and KPIs relevant for internal and customer use case scenarios. Work will involve designing, developing & maintaining system performance models that can simulate automotive use cases and generate analysis reports for performance, power & thermal analysis, then support new generation SoC product definition and design.
A background in SoC architecture fundamentals, and basic understanding of internal HW IPs, and system modelling development is preferred. Candidate is also expected to have strong analytic skills to distill & interpret model output metrics to indicate impact to SoC performance.
Role & Responsibilities
Implementing a defined performance analysis methodology to support product-level decision making. Such methodology would cover SoC performance architecture, use cases analysis and behavioral modeling for IP such as ISP, NPU or GPU.
Developing and maintaining platforms for automotive performance analysis methodology to enable scalable modeling of complex automotive use cases.
Working with SW teams to prepare & maintain measurement database for online access in the models
Modelling SoC level use cases for automotive concurrencies and maintaining a version controlled traceable summary of each analysis for our customers.
Support on-silicon analysis of use case dataflows, validating performance in the SoC and provide guidance on potential system optimizations to improve performance and/or reduce power/thermal footprints
Provide regular updates to functional teams regarding validated results improving accuracy of performance tools by correlating with measurements
Maintain a repository of archived data and documentation to support the model development & customer reports
Creating Automation of workloads\testcases based on Python scripts or other modeling language (ex. UML)
Good written and verbal communication skills are needed to present analyses and proposals to Qualcomm’s internal and external customers
Minimum Requirements
Candidate should have a minimum of 9 years of experience in the following areas in the Bachelor’s (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering. The desired skillsets are
Experience with SoC level performance modeling for complex use case concurrencies.
Ability to work across diverse teams within Qualcomm and engage with customers
Proficiency in C/C++, SystemC and Python programming
Experience in maintaining code repository (e.g. github) and automation scripts using Perl or Python for regressions testing (e.g. Jenkins).
A user web interface development and back-end data-base tool experience will be an advantage.
Candidates with some experience in machine learning implementations would be an advantage.
Past experience working in a globally distributed team would be a distinct advantage with a strong focus on clear communication & strong inter-personal skills.
Preferred Requirements
IP HW architecture experience on CPU, GPU, NPU or ISP.
Systems Engineer experience on Automotive SoC projects

General Summary:
Job Description
The candidate will work in a fast-paced, high-energy team focusing
on linux kernel gaming scheduler development on Android phone platform.

Qualcomm-446721454930.title: Camera ISP Algorithm System Engineer
Qualcomm-446721454930.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Camera Engineering
General Summary:
We seek a passionate engineer with in-depth knowledge on camera auto exposure/tone algorithm/tuning to join the Camera Systems team.
The Camera Systems team creates embedded imaging solutions for Snapdragon chipsets that power advanced mobile devices. Our solutions leverage dedicated hardware, multi-core processors, DSP, and GPU cores to provide state-of-the-art photographs, video recordings, as well as scene data for image understanding and object detection. Responsibilities include the following:
- Research and development for next generation camera features and image quality improvement.
- Prototype solutions on mobile platforms for proof of concept and demonstration purposes.
- Deployment and tuning support of solutions that improve the mobile imaging experience.
- Design of camera systems that balance power, memory, silicon area to maximize imaging performance.
- - Design auto exposure / tone algorithm to achieve best camera image auto exposure quality.
- - Design image processing algorithm and acceleration on CPU/GPU/DSP.
Qualification
- 5+ years working experiences in the following areas:
- Camera and image processing technologies.
- Expert at camera 3A algorithm design and implementation.
- Deep understanding of ISP pipeline and brightness modules, mobile camera sensors and optics.
- Linux SW development experience.
- Hands-on experience developing algorithms for mobile devices.
- Image signal processor pipeline design.
- Customer support/ camera tuning experience.
- C, C++, Python, Matlab.
- familiar with digital camera basic concept, proficient in Lightroom/Photoshop editing tool and LUTs implement is better.
Physical Requirements
• Frequently transports between offices, buildings, and campuses up to ½ mile.
• Frequently transports and installs equipment up to 5 lbs.
• Performs required tasks at various heights (e.g., standing or sitting).
• Monitors and utilizes computers and test equipment for more than 6 hours a day.
• Continuous communication which includes the comprehension of information with colleagues, customers, and vendors both in person and remotely.

Qualcomm-446721088967.title: Camera Software Customer Engineer
Qualcomm-446721088967.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in.
Qualcomm's QCT Application Engineering Group supports customers with all aspects of embedded software and systems development. This includes assisting OEMs with designs, providing training, debugging, assistance in optimizing and integrating software. We are seeking candidates to support new camera use cases and issues from Qualcomm China customers.
You will get in this position:
Deep and broad understanding of the most advanced camera/imaging technologies.
Involved in product definition and feature development of the latest module of smartphones and change the way people to record their lives.
Competitive salaries and a generous benefits package.
Long-term development in the abilities such as project management, business development, etc.
The candidate is expected to work on the following aspects:
Provide direct support to OEMs with the design, development and debug of Qualcomm reference designs software related issues
Quickly assimilate onto an existing project, understand s/w driver architecture, demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities and work closely with external customers to customize and launch their new products.
Support Qualcomm customer to enable different camera solutions and use cases.
Work with customer to enable Qualcomm new camera feature and algorithms on customer projects.
Some travels will be required in order to collaborate across multiple locations.
As our valuable team member, we hope you have been equipped with the fundamental capabilities below:
Strong background and hands-on experience in camera module and bring up related areas.
Understand image process pipeline and camera h/w architecture.
Familiar with Android/Linux driver architecture and experience on debug related issues.
Strong software development skills, C and C++ programming, problem analysis, and debugging skills.
Knowledge in real-time microprocessor-based embedded programming and embedded real-time operating systems.
Qualcomm-446721088967.requirements:
2 - 5 years experience on android camera development area.
Strong knowledge of and experience in Linux Kernel, Device Driver Model
Strong C & C++ programming and debugging skills required.
Experience in Linux camera sensor driver bring-up.
Experience in Camera framework
Experience in Camera ISP pipeline
Experience in Camera performance and power optimization
Knowledge of 3A algorithms, tuning experiences and familiarity with MIPI, I2C, GPIOs, V4L2 a plus.
Experience on Image Signal Processing.
Experience in Multimedia software development engineering for Linux based embedded systems.
Strong communication skills - able to understand and explain highly technical information in a clear and concise manner.
Willing travel to customer sites and other Qualcomm office locations to co-develop next generation smartphones.
Exceptional English communication skill.
Outgoing, positive and optimistic personality
Preferred Qualifications
Camera sensor driver, VCM driver, flash driver, PLD gating
3A algorithm improvement and bug fix
Camera FRM/HAL support
Still image driver developing, including JPG, PNG, GIF, etc.
New Image processing algorithm development and bug fix
Camera Power and performance profiling and optimization
Support customer for the customization features
On-site for customer urgent issues support
Prior experience with Qualcomm Camera Architecture
Worked on Qualcomm Chipset Projects
Education Requirements
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related
Minimum Qualifications:

Qualcomm-446721651650.title: Customer Engineer, IoT Connectivity Systems
Qualcomm-446721651650.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Applications Engineering
General Summary:
Join Qualcomm's Hardware Customer Engineering team to support IoT connectivity solutions and customer product enablement. This role combines customer-facing technical support, connectivity systems expertise, and system-level hardware engineering. You will collaborate with customers and ecosystem partners to drive product commercialization through hardware bring-up, design reviews, connectivity validation, debugging, root-cause analysis, and system-level troubleshooting. The ideal candidate has strong hardware fundamentals, a solid understanding of embedded and MCU-based systems, and hands-on experience with connectivity technologies such as Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. A good understanding of wireless communication principles and connectivity system behavior, including RF performance, receiver/transmitter concepts, coexistence, interoperability, and troubleshooting methodologies, is highly desirable. Experience with IoT connectivity products, power optimization, and wireless certification is a plus.
Responsibilities
·    Provide technical support for customer products leveraging IoT connectivity solutions.
·    Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of hardware, connectivity, performance, and system-level issues.
·    Perform validation, debugging, performance characterization, and design reviews across RF, antenna, power, and system integration domains.
·    Collaborate with customers, ecosystem partners, and engineering teams to enable successful product development and commercialization.
·    Create technical documentation and deliver customer-facing technical guidance and enablement.
Qualcomm-446721651650.requirements:
·    1+ years of experience with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or other connectivity technologies.
·    1+ years of experience in hardware bring-up, validation, debugging, failure analysis, or customer support.
·    Strong foundation in hardware design, embedded systems, and wireless communications.
·    Ability to analyze schematics, datasheets, and system-level designs.
·    Hands-on experience with laboratory test and measurement equipment, including WLAN/BT test systems.
·    Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
·    Self-driven, customer-focused, and able to manage multiple priorities.
·    Effective English communication skills in a global engineering environment.
Preferred Qualifications
·    Background in wireless communications, connectivity systems, or RF engineering.
·    Familiarity with RF, antenna, coexistence, wireless certification, and connectivity system fundamentals.
·    Familiarity with embedded and connectivity system architecture, including board bring-up, boot flow, interface debugging, and hardware-software interaction.
·    Experience working with customers, ecosystem partners, ODMs/OEMs, or certification laboratories.
·    Experience with Python-based scripting or test automation.
·    Experience with Qualcomm® connectivity products and platforms.
·    6+ years of experience in wireless communications or related fields is preferred for consideration at higher career levels
Education
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a related field. A master's degree is preferred.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

Qualcomm-446706877243.title: Functional Safety Software Architect
Qualcomm-446706877243.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
General Summary
Qualcomm is leveraging its expertise in wireless and computing technologies to drive a major technological revolution in the automotive industry. Having led the way in connected car technologies for over a decade, Qualcomm is now at the forefront of advancements in Automotive Infotainment, Telematics, ADAS/Autonomous Driving, and related technologies. The company is investing in cutting-edge innovations such as 5G, Cellular V2X, Computer Vision, and AI/Deep Learning. Collaborating closely with global automakers, Tier-1 suppliers, standards bodies, consortiums, and operators, Qualcomm is pushing the boundaries of automotive technology. The Qualcomm Automotive Team is seeking a functional safety software architect to contribute to the development of next-generation automotive solutions.
Qualcomm Automotive platform team is engaged in offering optimized solutions for the Qualcomm Automotive SoCs. We are seeking engineers with experience in system and SoC SW level functional safety concepts. The job requires understanding and defining of the Safety Concept and Architecture, Software Safety requirements, defining and deploying safety processes and development of Safety software by following the ISO26262 software processes. Interaction with customers, architects and test/integration teams are required as part of the job.  The job also involves working with the Software quality team for adherence of ISO26262 and ASPICE processes.
Responsibilities include but not limited to:
Lead functional safety initiatives for complex SoC software
Collaborate with development teams, partners, and customers on functional safety tasks
Engage in external/customer safety discussions, audits, and support corrective actions
Maintain expertise in automotive functional safety practices and drive timely gap closure
Enhance software processes and outputs to meet safety standards
Manage functional safety and architecture frameworks in automotive contexts
Define safety software architecture and requirements
Develop and implement robust safety plans
Ensure strict adherence to ISO26262 and ASPICE standards
Qualcomm-446706877243.requirements:
Master’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
5 – 10 years of industry experience in embedded software, especially in the automotive domain
Minimum 2 years’ experience in ISO26262 (Part 6 in specific)
Experience in functional safety software architecture in Automotive Domain: Safety software architecture specification, Safety Requirements definition, safety software development
Good understanding of functional safety software process, especially ISO26262 part-6
Experience in Safety Analysis (FMEA, DFA, FTA)
Experience in defining Software architecture, Software Design, and implementation of Embedded software for Automotive SoCs
Good understanding of SoC architecture, ARM architecture, SoC Peripherals, low level BSP Software/drivers, RTOS
Experience with tools for static analysis, code coverage
Knowledge and experience of ASPICE /ISO26262 or equivalent Quality standards
Knowledge of various tools and methods related for functional safety/ISO26262 (Requirements Management, Static/dynamic analysis, Safety Analysis, Safety software design, implementation, and testing)
Preferred Qualifications
Demonstrated knowledge and experience with ASPICE or comparable quality standards.
Relevant training or certifications in functional safety.
Proven ability to support customers and OEMs with functional safety and system safety concepts.
Experience conducting functional safety audits.
In-depth expertise in at least one technological domain (e.g., Linux, Android, QNX, Multimedia, Security, Virtualization, Performance, Stability, Machine Learning, etc.).
Self-motivated and adept at bridging software, hardware, systems, and commercialization disciplines.
Strong commitment to driving highly successful project outcomes.
Familiarity with China's functional safety standard GB/T 34590.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
•    4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Qualcomm-446718659840.title: GenAI Software Engineer
Qualcomm-446718659840.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
About us:
We are Qualcomm AI Research that are advancing AI to make its core capabilities – perception, reasoning, and action – ubiquitous across devices. Our mission is to make breakthroughs in fundamental AI research and scale them across industries. By bringing together some of the best minds in the field, we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible and shaping the future of AI. Welcome to visit our website at
AI Research Areas | Intelligence on Devices | Qualcomm
Key Responsibilities:
Design and develop end-to-end AI tools, models, and software to enable efficient deployment of quantized neural networks on cutting-edge Qualcomm hardware, with a strong focus on optimizing performance for speed, latency, memory, and power consumption
Deploy AI models to Qualcomm CPU/NPU/GPU using the QNN SDK toolchain
Develop debugging and profiling tools, as well as Qualcomm SDK solutions, to solve software issues and facilitate rapid on-device deployment of quantized models
Build and maintain automated test suites leveraging modern testing tools and frameworks
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design development/test approaches
Analyze test results and provide actionable feedback to the core development team
Preferred Skills and Experience:
Proficiency in Python and C/C++
Strong skills in software design, development, and debugging
Solid understanding of LLM computation graph optimization, including graph fusion, memory optimization, and execution scheduling.
Proven experience in optimizing LLM inference engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp) including scheduling and performance tuning for latency and throughput.
Experience with operator/kernel-level optimization for LLM workloads, such as attention, matmul, KV cache access, and memory bandwidth optimization.
Experience in Agentic AI pipeline and workflow
Hands-on experience with generative AI models, including LLMs and LVMs
Solid understanding of deep learning and experience with popular frameworks such as PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang with Hugging Face ecosystem
Practical experience with Release + CI/CD Pipeline for end-to-end integration, regression, stress, performance
Experience working with the Qualcomm QNN SDK is highly desirable
Experience with Android programming and trace analysis is a plus
Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude code, Codex, or Cursor is a plus

Qualcomm-446721534262.title: Performance & Modeling Engineer
Qualcomm-446721534262.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm Cloud AI is seeking an experienced
Performance & Modeling Engineer
to deploy, enable, benchmark, and optimize state-of-the-art AI models on Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms. In this role, you will leverage Qualcomm Cloud AI toolchains to rapidly bring up industry-leading AI workloads, analyze performance bottlenecks, drive model accuracy and performance optimization, and deliver best-in-class inference efficiency for cloud-scale AI deployments.
Key Responsibilities
Deploy and optimize LLM, MoE, and multimodal models on Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms.
Analyze and improve model accuracy, latency, throughput, memory utilization, and scalability.
Drive graph-level, framework-level, and system-level optimizations.
Benchmark AI workloads and identify performance bottlenecks across the software and hardware stack.
Work closely with compiler, runtime, kernel, and architecture teams to improve model enablement and performance.
Support customer deployment, bring-up, performance tuning, and production readiness.
Qualcomm-446721534262.requirements:
Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
Good verbal and written English communication skills to effectively collaborate across global teams.
Strong experience with Python, C++, and Linux development environments.
5+ years of experience in Cloud AI, LLM deployment, or AI infrastructure.
Deep understanding of Transformer architectures, LLMs, and MoE models.
Strong experience in graph optimization and model compilation workflows.
Strong experience in model accuracy and performance optimization.
Strong experience with one or more AI frameworks, including PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow, or JAX.
Experience with AI serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, TensorRT-LLM, or LMDeploy.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and large-scale inference systems.
Experience with Quantization, KV-Cache optimization, speculative decoding, continuous batching, Prefix Caching, Parallelism Strategies and distributed inference.
Experience with performance modeling and analysis methodologies, including Roofline analysis, bottleneck identification across software and hardware stacks.
Familiarity with open-source inference frameworks such as llama.cpp, Ollama, or MLC-LLM.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native AI infrastructure.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
