Qualcomm-446721898983.title: Performance Software Engineer
Qualcomm-446721898983.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
General Summary
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.
Major Job Responsibilities
Triage and solve application and system functionality & performance issues on Qualcomm compute platforms.
Develop new features for power/performance improvement on Qualcomm Computer platforms.
Work on open source projects migration to ARM architecture to improve compatibility and performance on Qualcomm compute platform.
Drive AI-native software development lifecycle (SDLC) transformation and establish best practices across the end-to-end software lifecycle, from idea to production.
Co-work with Chipset team for system performance projection, analysis and optimization.
Co-work with internal tech teams, program management team and CE team to promote Windows-on-ARM ecosystem in China.
Keep researching and learning cutting-edge technologies in the field of computing.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical, Information Systems or related field
1+ year of experience in embedded software with proficiency in C/C++/Python and hands-on experience in performance analysis and optimization on Windows or Android.
Understand the basic knowledge of OS Kernel (such as Windows, Linux Kernel, embedded RTOS kernel, etc.)
Understand system hardware/software architecture on Compute platforms.
Strong knowledge of AI-assisted reliability engineering, root cause analysis, and failure investigation methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiar with ARM architecture and experienced in ARM based low-level SW development
Experienced in Windows kernel, application/driver development and debugging.
Experienced in analyzing and optimizing Windows power and performance using ETW logs, performance tools (Windows performance toolkit, Xperf, etc).
Experienced with AI agents, workflow automation, and AI-native development practices.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to quickly learn, adapt to, and apply emerging technologies.
Good communication capabilities in both Chinese and English, fluent spoken English is preferred.

Qualcomm-446721299731.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm is looking for an experienced Power System Engineer who is passionate in solving power challenges and develops innovative solutions for optimizing power for Snapdragon wearable, camera and robotics Projects.
In this critical role, you will be responsible for the analysis and optimization power consumption across various stages of our project development process. You will take the lead and collaborate closely with chipset power and technology teams to ensure our products meet power efficiency requirements. You are expected to have knowledge about Linux power management system, suspend/resume flow, Linux idle state selection, CPUDCVS architecture.
Responsibilities include:
Identify power requirements and quantify power gap/risk areas, optimize power consumption to meet the requirements
Analyze and debug system sleep block issues, optimize button power consumption
Analyze high DDR/CPU utilization issues, and provide optimization methos
Generate comprehensive reports and presentations summarizing analysis results and providing actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams
Support CE to analysis customer power issue.
Qualcomm-446721299731.requirements:
A master’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent field is required as a minimum.
Strong experience in developing and utilizing performance and power models using languages such as C and Python.
Solid knowledge of power management techniques such as Linux suspend/resume flow and idle state selection
System knowledge of Linux CPUDCVS architecture, CPU frequency governor PELT/WALT algorithm
System knowledge of Linux devfreq architecture
System knowledge of Linux thermal management
Strong experience of power analysis usage such as systrace, simpleperf, etc
Ability to review hardware schematic
Better to have experience with camera power optimization
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Qualcomm-446714459752.title: Robotic Arm/Dexterous Hand Perception and Control Engineer
Qualcomm-446714459752.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering
General Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled expert with a strong theoretical foundation and hands-on engineering capabilities, specializing in motion planning and control of robotic arms and dexterous hands. This role involves deep participation in kinematic modeling, simulation validation, visual perception, and intelligent grasping strategy development, driving the intelligent application of robotic systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design and optimize kinematic and dynamic models for robotic arms and dexterous hands to achieve high-precision control and flexible manipulation
Develop path planning and task execution algorithms, including inverse kinematics, trajectory generation, obstacle avoidance, and multi-objective coordination
Build simulation environments for robotics and conduct algorithm validation and performance evaluation
Design and implement environmental perception modules for robotic arms/hands, including object recognition, pose estimation, and semantic segmentation
Develop reasoning strategy models and action models for robotic arms and dexterous hands
Collaborate with hardware and application teams to complete system integration and on-site debugging, enhancing robustness and generalization in real-world scenarios
Prepare technical documentation and contribute to patent applications, academic publications, and technical exchanges
Qualcomm-446714459752.requirements:
Master’s degree or above in Robotics, Automation, Computer Vision, or related fields
Solid understanding of kinematic modeling and control theory for robotic arms and dexterous hands
Proficient in at least one robotic simulation platform with relevant project experience
Experience in computer vision projects and familiarity with common perception models
Knowledge of control strategies for robotic arms and dexterous hands
Strong programming skills in Python and C++, with good coding practices and engineering capabilities
Excellent teamwork and cross-disciplinary communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with dexterous hand control, multi-finger grasping, or soft grippers
Participation in robotics competitions, open-source projects, or edge deployment
Experience developing robotic systems with multimodal perception and language understanding
Strong publication record or patent achievements
What We Offer
Exposure to cutting-edge robotics technologies and interdisciplinary research opportunities
Collaboration with top-tier research teams and participation in international projects and academic exchanges
Flexible work arrangements and an open, innovative technical environment
Competitive compensation and ample room for professional growth
Minimum Qualifications:

Qualcomm-446717763192.title: Robotics Solution Lead (Software Ecosystem & Architecture)
Qualcomm-446717763192.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Role Summary
We are seeking a
Principal/Director-level
technical leader to drive Robotics Solution strategy with a primary focus on
robotics software ecosystem
,
customer architecture insight
, and
future technology direction
. As robotics customers and ecosystem partners rapidly co-shape software stacks (OS/ROS, middleware, perception pipelines, AI integration, OTA, safety), this role will systematically connect external signals to internal roadmap decisions.
This position will define and influence the end-to-end robotics software solution architecture and ecosystem strategy around our Robotics SDK, developer experience, and partner
enablement—translating
customer/partner requirements into actionable product and engineering priorities.
Key Responsibilities
1) Robotics Software Ecosystem Strategy & Partnerships
Build and maintain a clear view of the robotics software ecosystem landscape (OS distributions, ROS2 ecosystem, middleware/DDS, simulation, tooling, CI/CD, OTA, safety frameworks) and identify strategic gaps/opportunities.
Engage ecosystem partners (robot OEMs, ISVs, SIs, open-source communities) to influence architecture choices and drive adoption of our robotics software stack and developer workflows.
Shape upstream/open-source posture to accelerate developer adoption and ecosystem credibility (e.g., ROS2 packages, documentation, distribution).
2) Customer Architecture Insight & Technical Advisory
Act as a senior technical interface for strategic robotics customers in China, capturing architecture decisions and pain points across the stack (OS/ROS, middleware, perception, AI/ML, diagnostics, OTA, safety).
Translate customer architecture insights into clear internal artifacts: architecture briefs, reference blueprints, prioritized capability asks, and decision memos for leadership.
Drive alignment between customer needs and our Robotics SDK evolution, ensuring solution-level coherence beyond point optimizations.
3) Future Technology Direction & Roadmap Influence
Identify future-facing technology trends and evaluate implications for our solution roadmap (real-time + AI reasoning, graph runtimes, deterministic scheduling, hardware acceleration integration,
simulation/regression
workflows).
Influence product and engineering roadmaps with a solution-first view, balancing near-term customer wins with long-term platform strategy.
4) Internal Leadership & Cross-Functional Execution
Lead cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Program, BD/CE on solution architecture and ecosystem priorities; drive crisp ownership and decision-making.
Define success criteria and measurable outcomes for ecosystem and architecture initiatives (e.g., reference architecture adoption, partner enablement milestones, SDK capability readiness).
Qualcomm-446717763192.requirements:
Deep experience in robotics software architecture and systems integration across Linux/Ubuntu, ROS2, middleware/DDS, perception pipelines, and runtime performance considerations.
Proven customer-facing technical leadership: ability to drive architecture discussions with senior engineers/architects at OEMs/partners and synthesize inputs into actionable internal direction.
Strong understanding of developer experience principles (SDK packaging, documentation, samples, tooling) and ecosystem adoption mechanics.
Excellent communication skills: able to write concise architecture briefs and present to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)
Hands-on experience with simulation, and performance/power profiling workflows for robotics software stacks.
Experience driving open-source contributions or upstream engagement in robotics communities.
Familiarity with hardware acceleration enablement for robotics workloads and heterogeneous compute integration (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
•    4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Qualcomm-446719413106.title: Senior Android XR Software Engineer – AR Glasses & Data Systems (Shanghai, China)
Qualcomm-446719413106.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering
General Summary:
Job Overview
Sensors‑based technology enables a wide range of applications, including navigation, gaming, advanced user interfaces, multimedia, and AR/VR experiences. This role offers hands‑on exposure to advanced sensor technologies used in smartphones, IoT devices, wearables, smart glasses, and other consumer electronics within the QCT Sensors Technology group.
We are seeking a hands-on Android XR Software Engineer to develop next-generation applications for AR glass form factors, enabling large-scale sensor data collection and sensors-based feature and context aware applications.
Initial focus areas are:
Enable multi-device data collection across AR, mobile, and wearables
Develop AR glass context aware applications for early-stage platforms
Work with prototype hardware and evolving Android XR platforms
You will work on both early-stage hardware platforms and commercial devices, contribute to system design, and help bring innovative sensor-driven experiences from concept to commercialization.
The position spans the full product lifecycle—from research and development through validation and commercial deployment—and involves close collaboration with systems, software, and integration/test engineers within the QCT Sensors Technology group.
Job responsibilities include:
Design, develop and test Android XR applications for AR glasses, including:
Glass-resident applications (UI, voice prompts, sensor interaction)
Companion Android mobile applications for control, synchronization, and data logging
Real-time context state visualization
Voice-driven feedback and user interaction
Optimize applications for long-term stability, battery life and robustness in real-world environments.
Design and implement multi-device data collection systems enabling synchronized logging across AR glasses, smartphones, and wearable devices.
Develop scalable, production-quality applications using Kotlin/Java and Android SDK that follow industry‑standard design patterns, development methodologies, and deployment models.
Support integration of XR, wearable and mobile application in compliance with enterprise deployment and device management concepts, such as Android Enterprise, mobile device management (MDM), and mobile application management (MAM).
Design, implement, and test cross‑platform desktop tools with user interfaces (Windows and Linux) that interact with Android devices used for sensor data collection and user demonstrations, supporting workflows such as device control, data validation, visualization, and post‑processing, using languages such as Java, Kotlin, Python, C++, .NET, and C#.
Develop software on prototype and reference platforms covering mobile devices, wearables, and smart‑glasses form factors
Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams to support the development and commercialization of sensor algorithms and features
Contribute to the design and evolution of end‑to‑end data processing pipelines, and monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing data workflows in production environments
Support internal data collection campaigns involving Qualcomm employees worldwide, including hands‑on participation in field data collection activities and resolving issues related to applications running in real-world environments on employees’ own devices
Support sensor feature commercialization across various form factors, including algorithm performance validation, customer data analysis, and direct customer triage support
The position is technology‑focused and involves participation in a broad range of sensor systems engineering activities within the Sensors Technologies group.
The role may involve occasional travel, physical or sports‑related activities, and handling of equipment with significant weight.

Fluency with Git and GitHub

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience developing applications for prototype or pre-commercial hardware

Qualcomm-446719413110.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering
General Summary:
Job Overview
Sensors-based technology enables a wide range of applications including navigation, gaming, advanced user interfaces, multimedia, and AR/VR experiences. This role offers hands-on exposure to advanced sensor technologies used in smartphones, IoT devices, wearables, smart glasses, and other consumer electronics.
We are seeking a hands-on Android XR System / SW / Data Engineer to acquire comprehensive AR glass data sets for training and validating sensors-based feature and context-aware features for AR glass form factors.
Initial focus areas are:
Enable multi-device data collection across AR glasses and mobile and wearable devices.
Hands-on data collection, validation, and labeling of AR-glass-based data sets covering a person’s daily life, public and private transport, and dedicated targeted data collection campaigns. Management of crowdsourced data collection campaigns using AR, mobile and wearable form factors.
Work with both commercial and prototype hardware and evolving Android XR platforms.
The position spans the full product lifecycle—from research and development through validation and commercial deployment—and involves close collaboration with systems, software, and integration/test engineers within the QCT Sensors Technology group.
Job responsibilities include:
Further develop, validate, maintain, and monitor the Qualcomm Sensors Team data collection platform. The initial emphasis would be with AR glasses and sensors related use cases for them.
Support and manage global data collection campaigns involving Qualcomm staff, including hands‑on participation in field data collection using mobile, wearable devices and AR glasses.
Analyze, summarize, label, and generate metrics for datasets containing physical and virtual sensor streams, location data, and radio scans (Wi‑Fi, WWAN, BLE) across smartphones, laptops, wearables, AR/XR glasses, and IoT devices.
Create, validate, maintain, and document training, validation, and test datasets to support algorithm and feature development.
Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams to support development and commercialization of sensor algorithms and features.
The position is technology-focused and involves participation in a broad range of sensors systems engineering activities within the Sensors Technologies group.
The role contains occasional travel, physical/sports activities, and handling of objects with significant weight.

Qualcomm-446721805305.title: System Architect Principal Engineer
Qualcomm-446721805305.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering
General Summary:
Define and advance Packet Processing Engine (PPE) architectures for broader product use cases, including automotive and TSN, while optimizing performance, power, and cost. Partner with Hardware Design, Verification, Software, Product Management, and Product Planning to translate requirements into scalable solutions. Develop models, prototypes, simulations, and workload analyses to validate architectural choices. Lead innovation across packet classification and processing, queueing, scheduling, shaping, resource allocation, and time-sensitive networking.
Operates independently and provides technical leadership across PPE architecture, design, verification, and validation.
Mentors engineers and aligns cross-functional teams on feature correctness, performance, schedule, and delivery readiness.
Communicates complex technical decisions clearly and influences stakeholders across product, software, and implementation teams.
Defines near- and mid-term PPE technical plans, modeling methods, validation strategies, and roadmap priorities.
Resolves ambiguous, highly complex problems and drives innovative ideas from architecture through implementation.
PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Define PPE performance, power, cost, and feature requirements, including automotive and TSN needs.
Design complex forwarding-plane features and identify architectural improvements.
Translate product and software objectives into implementable PPE designs.
Track industry trends and apply relevant innovations to PPE solutions.
Lead design, verification, validation, and review activities; identify systemic issues and drive resolution.
Guide modeling, simulation, and KPI analysis to support architectural decisions.
Support verification coverage, model-to-design alignment, software enablement, and feature bring-up.
Serve as a PPE subject-matter expert and produce clear specifications and technical documentation.
REQUIRED COMPETENCIES:
(All competencies below are required upon entry)
Analytical thinking:
Integrate data from multiple sources, identify patterns, and draw sound conclusions.
Collaboration and trust:
Build effective relationships, honor commitments, and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Communication:
Present technical and non-technical information clearly to varied audiences.
Innovation:
Generate practical new ideas and build support to turn them into solutions.
Decision-making:
Evaluate alternatives quickly and account for business and technical impact.
Execution:
Plan, prioritize, manage multiple workstreams, and overcome obstacles.
Mentoring:
Coach others and support their technical and professional development.
Technical expertise:
Apply strong systems and technology knowledge to PPE architecture.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
12+ years of experience in networking datapath, packet processing, ASIC architecture, or related work.
Proven ability to translate product and software requirements into PPE architectures and support Design, Verification, Validation, and Software teams.
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:
Master's or Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
15+ years of networking architecture or design experience.
Strong independent execution and professional English and Chinese communication skills.
3+ years working with senior executives and 4+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.

Qualcomm-446720950950.title: System Power Test Engineer
Qualcomm-446720950950.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Responsibilities
Responsible for mobile power test execution, characterization, analysis and optimization of multimedia use cases, with a primary focus on Camera and Video workloads. In this position, the technical area will involve the whole system including CPU, ISP, NPU, DDR, VPU, DPU, PMIC and so on. It is easier to gain deep understanding of system architecture.
Support product test and provide reliable test data and report across different functional teams.
Perform power breakdown for Camera cases and other user scenarios and capture related logs to analyze the system behavior.
Identify the platform issues and provide analysis to identify the root cause based on available logs.
Support internal feature development testing and involve feature design and design corresponding use cases.
Optimize test procedure, develop test case, extend the test check point and debugging method to find more platform issues.
Support customer reported issue and related feature development testing, co-work with Dev team to tuning best parameter to balance power and performance.
Maste power related knowledge and identify potential power optimization via testing.
Skills/Experience
1 to 10 years of system testing or software development experience in Power/Performance/Camera/CoreBSP or other related areas.
Good understanding of system power or performance, related test and development experience is a plus.
Good Knowledge in Camera/ISP, CPU, DDR, Embedded system, Kernel, Linux/Android framework.
Have Android related system testing and debugging skills, familiar with Android/Linux commands and logging methods.
Good at communicating and collaborating across teams, good initiative capacity is a plus.
Familiar with hardware and PMIC is a plus.
Good communication skills both in Chinese and English.

Qualcomm-446718829154.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Test Engineering
General Summary:
Job Description
Responsibilities:
Independently own robotic ROS / SLAM / perception feature testing, including test plan, test design, execution, bug analysis, and closure tracking.
Research and define the scope, metrics, and methodology of a robotics performance database (e.g. SLAM KPIs). Own end-to-end execution, including data collection, analysis, maintenance, and reporting.
Continuously improve test efficiency by automation/tools
Skill Requirements
:
Solid experience in robotics software testing, with exposure to areas such as ROS, SLAM, perception, navigation.
Experience of Python is required.
Good understanding of performance testing and benchmarking methodologies (CPU/GPU/DSP/memory/latency).
Ability to work independently and take full ownership of test areas and projects.
Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
Strong English skills in reading, writing, and technical communication.
Experience in project-level ownership or leading test initiatives is a strong plus.
BS 6+ or MS 3+ experience of embedded products software testing.
Education Requirements:
BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Communication Engineering.

Qualcomm-446721805205.title: ASIC Design Senior Staff Engineer
Qualcomm-446721805205.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm-446721805205.requirements:
Deep expertise in ASIC development, especially logic design, RTL coding, verification, synthesis, timing closure and physical design flow
Deep expertise in Ethernet architecture, including:
Forwarding pipelines (L2/L3, ACLs, tunneling)
Traffic management (QoS, scheduling, shaping)
High-performance packet processing and scaling strategies
Strong leadership and cross-functional influence capability
Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills
Excellent teamwork, interpersonal and communication skills.
Fluent in Chinese and English both verbal and written.
Ability to work in stressful situations with tight schedules to meet.
Description of Function & Responsibility
Drive architecture definition and technical strategy for next-generation Ethernet switch or PON ASICs, enabling scalable, high-performance networking solutions.
Define architecture and roadmap for Ethernet and packet processing subsystems
Lead design across multiple subsystems (forwarding engine, traffic management, scheduling, resource allocation)
Drive cross-functional alignment with HW, SW, and Product teams on networking features and performance targets
Lead performance analysis, modeling, and trade-off studies for switch architecture
Mentor senior technical leaders and influence organization-wide engineering direction
Ensure successful execution from architecture through silicon delivery
Education:
MS in EE.
Experience:
8 to 12+ years ASIC design/architecture experience. Experience in merchant silicon or Ethernet or PON is highly desirable.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

Qualcomm-446720445177.title: SOC Senior Program Manager
Qualcomm-446720445177.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management
General Summary:
GENERAL SUMMARY:
Drives and monitors SoC programs from initiation through planning, execution, and delivery to program closure.
The responsibilities of this role include:
Developing plans of record for SoC programs, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables and risks
Executing plan of SoC programs through whole chip development and validation stages till production
Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and detailed information to multiple stakeholders to align targets, close gaps and fix issues.
Tracking plan of SoC programs progress, issues, risks, costs and deliverables in regular reports
Representing the program and driving alignment across stakeholders.
REQUIRED COMPETENCIES:
(All competencies below are required upon entry)
SoC development knowledge  – The experience of whole process of large scale SoC development or program management.
Communication - The ability to convey information clearly and accurately, as well as choosing the most effective method of delivery (e.g., email, phone, face-to-face). This includes using a technically sound communication style both verbally and in writing.
Program Management - Knowledge of program management methodology (e.g., planning, scheduling, tracking, execution). This includes the ability to effectively use program management tools to carry out the program management function.
Risk Management - The ability to identify (e.g., impact analysis) and mitigate risks that impact programs. This includes prioritizing and tracking risks.
Analytical Skills - The ability to collect information and identify fundamental patterns/trends in data. This includes the ability to gather, integrate, and interpret information from several sources.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Master's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related field.
PMP Certification.
10+ years Program Management experience or related work experience.
5+ years experience working on large SoC or GPU or CPU products.
5+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with customers.
Qualcomm-446720445177.requirements:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
•    5+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

Company:

General Summary:
Arduino is now part of the Qualcomm organization!
Are you passionate about building strong, vibrant ecosystems that enable innovation at scale?
Arduino is looking for a
3rd Party Products Product Manager
to drive the growth of our global third‑party ecosystem—empowering partners, manufacturers, and creators around the world to build exceptional products on top of Arduino technology.
In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of product, partnerships, and hardware enablement. You will collaborate closely with external manufacturers, module vendors, accessory makers, and ecosystem contributors to expand the universe of high‑quality third‑party products compatible with Arduino.
You will travel frequently across key manufacturing and innovation hubs to nurture relationships, evaluate partner capabilities, and bring new ecosystem solutions to life.
This is a highly impactful, outward‑facing role for someone who thrives on building global relationships, enabling partners, and shaping a scalable hardware ecosystem.
What We Offer
A dynamic role in a rapidly growing company shaping the future of open‑hardware innovation
Competitive compensation and benefits
A mission‑driven culture with diverse and talented international teams
Personalized growth paths and a dedicated annual training budget
Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work–life balance

Drive Partner Development

Develop processes to scale the ecosystem sustainably as Arduino’s global footprint grows

Qualcomm-446706877242.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
General Summary
Qualcomm is leveraging its expertise in wireless and computing technologies to drive a major technological revolution in the automotive industry. Having led the way in connected car technologies for over a decade, Qualcomm is now at the forefront of advancements in Automotive Infotainment, Telematics, ADAS/Autonomous Driving, and related technologies. The company is investing in cutting-edge innovations such as 5G, Cellular V2X, Computer Vision, and AI/Deep Learning. Collaborating closely with global automakers, Tier-1 suppliers, standards bodies, consortiums, and operators, Qualcomm is pushing the boundaries of automotive technology. The Qualcomm Automotive Team is seeking platform software SME (Subject Matter Expert) to contribute to the development of next-generation automotive solutions.
Responsibilities include but not limited to:
Leverage technical subject matter expertise to identify customer pain points.
Translate customer feedback into actionable project scope.
Partner with both internal and external teams in defining or selecting appropriate software solutions.
Review and provide support during the detailed design phase, offering recommendations and making decisions regarding software implementation.
Oversee requirements and conduct solution reviews for core platform technologies, including bootloaders (XBL/UEFI), Linux peripheral drivers, firmware, access controls, IPC, and hypervisors (Gunyah, QNX) etc.
Leverages advanced Software knowledge and experience to design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.
Availability in key meetings pertinent to the technical discussions
Effectively communicate technical solutions to both internal and external audiences as required.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science/ engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
6-8 years of software experience in embedded software development for ARM based systems

SW Development background in Embedded Systems. Good C/C++, Rust etc. programming and analytic skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience in at least 3 or more areas in Linux kernel, Micro kernels like QNX, Bootloaders, SoC architecture, ARM architecture, SoC/ARM security, Virtualization and Hypervisors, SoC Low-power management frameworks, performance analysis, Device drivers (USB, PCIe, Ethernet, Storage, DDR, UART, I2C, SPI etc.), strong C programming and SoC HW debugging
Proficiency in MCU RTOS or AUTOSAR software
Self-driven and comfortable spanning software, hardware, system, and commercialization skills.
High level of focus on ensuring very successful projects.
Proven ability to identify and solve complex engineering problems.
Ability to utilize both technical and leadership experience.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Qualcomm-446721900069.title: Linux Kernel Engineer
Qualcomm-446721900069.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Company Overview
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in.
Job Overview
We are seeking a talented and experienced engineer to lead the design and development of Linux Kernel features for our next-generation IoT products. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end architecture and implementation of critical kernel subsystems, ensuring optimal performance, power efficiency, and stability on Qualcomm SoCs.
As a technical lead, you will drive the software strategy for IoT platforms, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with hardware, system, and upstream communities to deliver cutting-edge Linux solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership:
Lead the design and architecture of Linux Kernel features for IoT products, including high-level OS design, driver frameworks, and system optimization.
Kernel Development:
Design, implement, and debug complex kernel drivers and subsystems (e.g., Scheduler, Memory Management, Power Management, Remoteproc/IPC).
Upstreaming:
Actively participate in the Linux open-source community; review code, submit patches, and ensure Qualcomm features are upstreamed to the mainline kernel.
Optimization:
Analyze and optimize system performance (throughput, latency) and power consumption for battery-powered IoT devices.
Collaboration:
Work closely with hardware designers, system architects, and test teams to define software requirements and resolve complex cross-domain issues.
Mentorship:
Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers, conducting code reviews and fostering best practices in kernel development.

Qualcomm-446721900069.full_text:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Company Overview
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in.
Job Overview
We are seeking a talented and experienced engineer to lead the design and development of Linux Kernel features for our next-generation IoT products. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end architecture and implementation of critical kernel subsystems, ensuring optimal performance, power efficiency, and stability on Qualcomm SoCs.
As a technical lead, you will drive the software strategy for IoT platforms, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with hardware, system, and upstream communities to deliver cutting-edge Linux solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership:
Lead the design and architecture of Linux Kernel features for IoT products, including high-level OS design, driver frameworks, and system optimization.
Kernel Development:
Design, implement, and debug complex kernel drivers and subsystems (e.g., Scheduler, Memory Management, Power Management, Remoteproc/IPC).
Upstreaming:
Actively participate in the Linux open-source community; review code, submit patches, and ensure Qualcomm features are upstreamed to the mainline kernel.
Optimization:
Analyze and optimize system performance (throughput, latency) and power consumption for battery-powered IoT devices.
Collaboration:
Work closely with hardware designers, system architects, and test teams to define software requirements and resolve complex cross-domain issues.
Mentorship:
Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers, conducting code reviews and fostering best practices in kernel development.
Minimum Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
Experience:
12+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
Technical Skills:
Rich experience with ARM based IOT products
Expert proficiency in
C programming
and data structures.
Deep understanding of
Linux Kernel internals
(e.g., Process Scheduler, Memory Management, Interrupt handling, Synchronization, Device Model).
Extensive experience with
Device Driver development
on embedded systems (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, USB, PCIe).
Experience with
ARMv8/ARM64
architecture and low-level software/hardware interaction.
Proficiency with
Git
and Linux build systems (Make, Kconfig).

Domain Expertise:
Proven track record of
upstreaming
contributions to the Linux Kernel (please provide links to patches/LKML discussions).
Experience with

build environments.

technologies (KVM, VirtIO, Type-1 Hypervisors).

Soft Skills:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and lead projects in a fast-paced, global environment.
Minimum Qualifications:

Qualcomm-446722166145.title: Linux Kernel Engineer
Qualcomm-446722166145.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
We are looking for an experienced
Linux Kernel Engineer at the Senior/Staff level
to work on Linux kernel enablement for next-generation
mobile and compute platforms
.
The role will focus on
chipset baseport, platform bring-up, and memory subsystem enablement
, working across kernel, firmware, bootloader, and hardware boundaries. The ideal candidate has strong Linux kernel fundamentals, hands-on experience bringing up complex SoCs, and excellent debugging skills.
Experience with
virtualization technologies such as KVM/pKVM
is highly desirable.
Responsibilities
Drive
Linux kernel baseport and chipset bring-up
for new mobile and compute SoCs.
Enable and debug core platform functionality during early silicon and product development.
Work on the Linux
memory subsystem
, including areas such as:
Virtual and physical memory management
Page allocation and reclamation
Memory mapping and address translation
CMA and reserved memory
DMA and IOMMU/SMMU interactions
Memory pressure, fragmentation, and performance
Memory protection and isolation
Diagnose complex issues spanning
Linux kernel, device drivers, firmware, bootloader, and hardware
.
Analyze kernel crashes, hangs, memory corruption, boot failures, performance regressions, and other low-level system issues.
Work closely with hardware, firmware, BSP, virtualization, performance, and product teams to resolve platform-level issues.
Develop and upstream high-quality kernel patches where appropriate.
Participate in architecture/design reviews and provide technical leadership for kernel and platform enablement.
Mentor engineers and help establish effective kernel development and debugging practices.
Support kernel enablement across both
mobile and compute
product environments.
Qualcomm-446722166145.requirements:
BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Significant professional experience with
Linux kernel development
, preferably for ARM/ARM64-based SoCs.
Strong understanding of Linux kernel architecture and major kernel subsystems.
Hands-on experience with
SoC/chipset bring-up and baseport development
.
Solid understanding of the Linux memory-management subsystem.
Strong C programming skills and experience developing/debugging kernel code and device drivers.
Good understanding of low-level system concepts, including:
ARM64 architecture
MMU and page tables
Interrupts
Device Tree and/or ACPI
DMA and IOMMU/SMMU
Cache coherency
Boot flow and firmware/kernel interfaces
Experience debugging difficult kernel and system-level problems using tools and techniques such as:
ftrace / tracepoints
perf
crash / vmcore analysis
kdump
kernel sanitizers such as KASAN
dynamic debug and kernel instrumentation
JTAG or hardware-assisted debugging where applicable
Ability to independently drive complex technical issues from initial symptom through root-cause analysis and resolution.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with
KVM, pKVM, or ARM virtualization architecture
.
Understanding of ARM exception levels, Stage-1/Stage-2 translation, VHE/nVHE, and virtualization-related memory management.
Experience with Linux memory-management internals such as buddy allocator, SLUB, reclaim, compaction, CMA, huge pages, NUMA, or memory hotplug.
Experience with
IOMMU/SMMU
, DMA mapping, memory protection, or confidential/isolated execution environments.
Experience working on Android/mobile Linux and/or Ubuntu or other Linux distributions for compute platforms.
Experience with upstream Linux kernel development and contribution workflows.
Experience debugging issues requiring correlation of
kernel software behavior with firmware and hardware state
.
Familiarity with power management, scheduler, CPU frequency/idle, interrupt controller, or other core kernel subsystems is a plus.
What We Value
For the
Staff-level
role in particular, we are looking for engineers who can go beyond implementing individual features. Successful candidates should be able to:
Own complex chipset/kernel problems with limited guidance.
Debug issues that cross traditional subsystem boundaries.
Build a system-level understanding from hardware through firmware to the Linux kernel.
Identify architectural problems rather than only fixing individual symptoms.
Influence technical direction and collaborate effectively across multiple engineering teams.
Mentor other engineers and raise the overall technical capability of the team.
Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
•    2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

- Skilled in debugging tools such as GDB, JTAG, ftrace, and perf;

Qualcomm-446721284280.title: Sales and Support Coordinator (Inside Sales)
Qualcomm-446721284280.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Sales Operations
General Summary:
ABOUT THE ROLE
The position is a fast-paced role at the sharp end of the business helping deliver Arduino’s ambitious growth targets for APAC
You’ll be part of the APAC team, with a key focus on protecting existing revenue for key accounts, identifying and winning new customers as well as working closely with global sales colleagues in Asia to make sure we give our business and end customers a consistently brilliant experience that keeps them coming back for more.
What you’ll be accountable for:
Full account management responsibilities of key accounts in Asia
Identifying and developing new customers in APAC for Arduino
Identifying up-sale and cross-sale opportunities whilst protecting existing revenue of key customer accounts.
Providing operational support to BDM & Sales Director and your customers with onboarding, quotations and order processing.
Resolving a variety of issues for our customers throughout APAC, in a timely manner and delivering the highest level of customer satisfaction.
Liaising with customers to provide post-order support for all sales orders.
Being the first point of contact for business customer enquiries via phone and email
Inside sales roles conducting potential new customer calls and visits
Managing customer profiles, issues, escalations and resolutions through our Enterprise Resource Planning system, and SAP, our Client Relationship Management system.
Working with vendors and colleagues in Operations, Supply Chain, Purchasing and Credit departments to resolve customer issues at top speed and with minimum fuss.
Supporting business build with projects, systems testing and process enhancements
Prepare Sales Update, reports, analytics and presentations
ABOUT YOU
You’ll need to be:
An exceptional team player with the ability to stay connected to colleagues across the globe.
Strong MS Office skills with the ability to create detailed reports with no issues.
Strong numeracy skills with the ability to make sense of data and numbers.
A proactive self-starter who stays motivated at all times.
Highly energetic and fun adding value to our culture and family.
An allrounder - someone who can wear many hats in true start-up style.
A cross-selling and up-selling sales skills.
Calm and unflappable under pressure.
Careful and accurate, with a keen eye for detail.
Influential and persuasive with a fantastic telephone manner.
An outstanding communicator with excellent written and spoken English.
Essential knowledge, skills and experience:
Minimum 5 years of experience of Inside sales, customer service & supporting function to senior managers in Sales & Marketing role
Working in a regional or global role with experience of dealing with customers from different countries and cultural backgrounds.
Working knowledge of Client Relationship Management (CRM) software and Netsuite (ERP) systems.
Strong PC skills in Microsoft Office – especially excel & powerpoint
Proficient in English language speaking and writing – ability to speak English fluently
Desirable knowledge, skills and experience:
Experience in electronics distribution industry as an Inside sales and sales coordinator role is preferred.
Knowledge and experience of Single Board Computing and IoT with a passion for electronics
Qualcomm-446721284280.requirements:
•    Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of Sales Operations or related work experience.
OR
Associate's degree and 4+ years of Sales Operations or related work experience.
OR
High School Diploma or equivalent and 6+ years of Sales Operations or related work experience.

Qualcomm-446717981173.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Product Marketing
General Summary:
Role Overview
As a
Product Manager for the Camera Product Line in China
, you will serve as the key link between
China market requirements
and
global R&D and product teams
. You will support BU to define
camera SoC and reference solutions
for
handheld cameras, IP/security cameras, and emerging camera-based products
to fulfill C
hina market requirement
.
This role requires translating
China-specific technology trends, regulatory requirements, and customer needs
into
actionable product roadmaps
. You will collaborate closely with
sales teams to define and execute Go‑to‑Market (GTM) strategies
, drive key
customer Design Wins
, and work with partners to
build a strong camera solution ecosystem in China
.
Key Responsibilities
1. Market Insight & Requirement Translation
Systematically collect, analyze, and structure
China camera market requirements
across
consumer, security, and industrial
segments.
Produce
PRDs and market analysis
to support global BU product definition and prioritization decisions.
Represent the
China market perspective
in global product planning and roadmap discussions.
2. Cross‑Region Product Definition Collaboration
Work closely with
HQ Business Units and R&D teams
to drive China‑market‑optimized product definitions.
Lead
SoC specification tailoring
,
reference design (EVK) optimization
,
software SDK adaptation
, and
differentiated feature definition
for China customers.
3. Go‑to‑Market (GTM) Strategy & Execution
Partner with
sales, marketing, and technical support teams
to define China GTM plans, including
pricing, channels, certification, lighthouse customer sampling, and product launch execution
.
Deliver a complete and executable
end‑to‑end GTM plan
.
4. Design Win Acceleration
Engage deeply with
key and high‑potential customers
at both technical and solution levels.
Lead
PoC validation, solution tuning, and mass‑production ramp‑up support
.
Take ownership of
Design Win conversion rate and Time‑to‑Market
results.
5. Competitive Landscape & Product Strategy
Continuously track
global and domestic competitors
, including camera SoC vendors and solution providers (e.g. Imvision, Ambarella, Novatek).
Deliver structured
competitive analysis reports
and define
differentiation strategies
to support market breakthroughs.
6. Ecosystem Development
Lead the establishment of a
China camera ecosystem alliance
.
Engage
distributors, ODM/OEM partners, and solution providers
to build a scalable camera solution ecosystem.

Qualcomm-446718265128.title: Staff Manager, Product Marketing — Automotive GenAI
Qualcomm-446718265128.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Product Marketing - SIP
General Summary:
Qualcomm is a leading supplier of chipset platforms for automotive infotainment. In this role, you will be part of the team responsible for driving the go-to-market strategy for
Automotive GenAI products and AI software stack
in China. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to promote Qualcomm's on-device AI technologies, industry-leading innovations in edge-side large language models, and product strategies across the AI application, engine, model, and silicon layers, while influencing key decisions across the product lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
AI Ecosystem Expansion: Lead ecosystem engagement with strategic partners and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers to drive adoption of Qualcomm's on-device GenAI solutions across China's automotive market.
AI Stack Product Competitiveness
:
Own competitive analysis against key rivals (e.g., NVIDIA), translate findings into product feature roadmaps, and maintain quarterly-refreshed deliverables including AI Stack Tech Manual (feature matrix, performance benchmarks).
Model Delivery & Optimization Coordination: Collaborate with AI SW product planning, model vendors, and leading OEMs to drive model delivery efficiency, quantization analysis automation, and GenAI technology adoption in China.
Develop and manage comprehensive communication plans engaging internal teams, customers, third-party partners, and senior management to build alignment, drive buy-in, and successfully manage planned changes.
Translate customer requirements, product roadmaps, and organizational strategy into winning product portfolios, and facilitate alignment and decision-making to ensure successful product delivery.
Qualcomm-446718265128.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
5–8 years of experience in Product Marketing or a related role within the semiconductor, automotive, or embedded systems industry.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in a technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Solid understanding of on-device AI / edge AI technology stack
, including inference engines, model quantization, and LLM deployment on embedded platforms.
Familiarity with mainstream AI frameworks and models
(e.g., llama.cpp, Transformer architectures, Qwen, etc.) and their optimization for NPU/HTP hardware accelerators.
Experience in automotive GenAI or intelligent cockpit ecosystem
, with established relationships with China OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, or AI solution providers.
Solid understanding of automotive infotainment EE architecture and key SoC IP blocks (CPU, GPU, NPU/HTP, DSP).
Strong knowledge of automotive infotainment and intelligent cockpit market trends and competitive landscape, especially in the China market.
Experience with competitive benchmarking and product positioning against industry leaders (e.g., NVIDIA).
Background or familiarity with mobile SoC platforms is a plus.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders across a matrixed organization.
Fluent in English and Chinese.

Qualcomm-446719061589.title: VP, Product Management
Qualcomm-446719061589.description:
Company:
Qualcomm China
Job Area:
Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management
General Summary:
Qualcomm is seeking a senior leader to drive Product Management for its portfolio in China, with end-to-end responsibility across
Handset, XR, V&M, and Wearable business segments
, as well as
technology product management across the full platform, including AP, modem, RFFE, connectivity, and AI etc
. This role defines and drives product strategies for China market, ensuring strong alignment between China market dynamics and global product roadmaps, and serving as a key member of the leadership team shaping Qualcomm’s long-term growth in China.
The role leads executive-level engagement with top OEMs and strategic partners, co-defining next-generation product and technology direction, and translating market and customer insights into differentiated platform strategies. It is accountable for driving competitive positioning, influencing critical roadmap and architecture decisions, and ensuring leadership across our product portfolio. The position requires the ability to operate at scale—balancing customer needs, business priorities, and technology evolution to deliver impactful outcomes.
In addition, this role also leads a team strengthening Qualcomm’s ecosystem in China, working across business units to enable collaboration with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders. This role is expected to drive cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, and commercial organizations globally, and leads a high-impact team to deliver innovative, competitive solutions that reinforce Qualcomm’s leadership in the market.
The position requires strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate and influence stakeholders in product management, engineering, marketing, finance, sourcing and sales teams.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Humanities, or related field.
15+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
Preferred Qualifications
MBA or Master's degree / PhD in a technical field of study
20+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
SOC system product and feature planning experience
Strong knowledge of neural networks, camera/video, CPU/GPU architecture
Strong understanding of China smartphone and smart devices customer and technology ecosystem
Ability to analyze and distill detailed data down to actionable product and business strategies
Strong communication skills (written/verbal/presentation)
In addition to experience, the successful candidate will have demonstrated competencies in the following areas:
Strategic Execution:
Ensures execution plan drives key strategic priorities and company goals; has significant impact on the direction of a large number of critical projects. Drives timely, complex, and strategic decisions that have a global reach and/or significant business or financial impact while adhering to Qualcomm standards of ethical behavior.
Coaching & Development:
Provides leadership across organizations (e.g., creates a strategy for organization development, develops a strong talent pipeline/workforce and drives talent development to execute present and future business priorities, sets clear expectations for departments, drives coaching and mentoring relationships, creates a culture of inclusion and learning) and motivates peers, senior leaders, and employees to align individual, team, department, and organization development with the broader vision and goals of the company.
Impactful Innovation:
Inspires stakeholders, the company culture, and the industry with a visionary approach that shapes the organization by introducing and enabling breakthrough ideas, products, and/or processes. Creates new business opportunities by challenging the organization to push boundaries while taking the appropriate risk and anticipating future needs.
Clear Communication:
Translates the strategic vision into succinct and impactful messages that inspires and connects efforts to the broader vision and goals of the company. Acts as a champion for proactive, open, respectful, and inclusive discussions.
